note: dHMN is classically differentiated from axonal CMT2 by the preservation of sensory nerve action potentials alongside motor axonal loss, which is corroborated in SPTAN1-related motor neuropathy reports.

evidence.text: Distal hereditary motor neuropathies caused by SPTAN1 variants are characterized by length-dependent lower motor neuron axonal degeneration with reduced compound muscle action potentials without significant sensory involvement.

source.title: Nonsense mutations in alpha-II spectrin in three families with juvenile onset hereditary motor neuropathy
source.quote: Distal hereditary motor neuropathies are a rare subgroup of inherited peripheral neuropathies hallmarked by a length-dependent axonal degeneration of lower motor neurons without significant involvement of sensory neurons.

evidence.text: Electrophysiological assessment in a Chinese family with an SPTAN1 nonsense variant demonstrated normal sensory nerve conduction velocities and normal sensory nerve action potentials across all tested nerves, confirming motor axonal neuropathy.

source.title: A novel de novo SPTAN1 nonsense variant causes hereditary motor neuropathy in a Chinese family
